params.body:
## Why

Hexon recognises a portal only by the code Stocklist sends with every vehicle (`vehiclePortalResource`). Since #1014 an administrator could add a portal, but the code was typed, and nothing checked it against Hexon:

- Nissan.be was created as `nissanbe`; Hexon's code is `nissanbelgie` (fixed by hand in production on 15 October 2026).
- Mycar (1 garage) has been sent as `mycar`; Hexon only knows `mycarlu`, so those vehicles never reached Mycar.
- Twelve portals (aanbod.be, chilli.be, Vivastreet.be, ...) have no garage and no Hexon link, and still sit on every dealer card.

## What

- **`resources/data/hexon-links.json`**: Hexon's 353 links (name, code, address, sites, a Belgian flag) as listed in DV Admin under the Stocklist Dealer account, read by `App\Support\HexonLinks`. A hand-made snapshot until Stocklist has API access; a newer list is a new commit.
- **Beheer > Portalen**
  - Adding a portal is picking a Hexon link: Belgian links without a search, a search for the rest. Name, code and address come from Hexon; no code is typed.
  - Every portal shows its route: through Hexon (including the premium rows sent as `2ehandsbe` / `marktplaats`), direct (Flexlease, Okasie, België/Nederland Mobiel), or a warning "onbekend bij Hexon".
  - Editing an unknown code offers Hexon's links to pick the right one; a code Hexon knows stays fixed.
  - A switch "aangeboden" takes a portal out of the offer.
- **`portals.offered`**: `Portals::choicesFor()` feeds the dealer card: offered portals plus the ones that garage already has, so a portal out of the offer can still be switched off where it is on. The migration takes the twelve dead portals out of the offer, only where no garage has them.
- Texts in nl, fr, en, de; rule R S2-4.10 rewritten.

## Checks

- `AdministratorsManageThePortalsTest` (8 tests): routes from the data file, list with routes and garage counts, dealer refused, Belgian links by default and search for the rest, add from Hexon (and refused for a code not on the list or already added), fixing an unknown code and refusing to change a known one, edit, offer switch and dealer card choices.
- Full suite: 3105 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as on main). PHPStan: no errors. Pint on the new PHP files.
- Screen rendered at 1440 px and 390 px.

## After merge

Mycar can be fixed on the screen (Bewerken, pick Mycar.lu). Whether the garage on Mycar has an account on Hexon's `mycarlu` link is a separate check in DV Admin.
